title: Exotic Sweet Middle Eastern Beef Flank Steak Baba Ganoush
description: A sweet and crumbly Middle Eastern dish featuring dehydrated beef flank steak, perfect for a post-workout meal, this macrobiotic-friendly baba ganoush is a twist on the classic recipe.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Slice the dehydrated beef flank steak into thin strips and set aside.
Pierce the eggplant with a fork a few times and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the eggplant from the oven and let it cool down.
Scoop the eggplant flesh into a blender and add the tahini, honey, lemon juice, garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Blend the mixture until smooth and creamy.
Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat and add the sliced beef flank steak.
Cook the beef for 5 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Combine the cooked beef with the eggplant mixture and serve.
